summary.text: Thomas Stewart is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a writer and political activist born and raised in Anderson County.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Thomas Stewart said he was born and raised in Anderson County, South Carolina, and works as a writer and political activist.

He said his campaign aims to resist and repeal legislation that treats South Carolinians differently because of sex, race, orientation, sexuality or country of origin, to reduce homelessness, and to fund a complete refurbishment of the state's roads and other infrastructure.

He named welfare reform and veteran care as the policy areas he cares most about, and said the state should use its budget surplus, which he put at $1.8 billion as of 2025, for long-term programs rather than short-term tax breaks.
